# Label printer setup

Everyone on the floor can use the label printer in room 2.14. Install the driver before you send the first print job.

## Install the driver

To install the driver, you should run this command in a terminal window:

```bash
sudo ./install-driver.sh --model LP-200 --queue floor2
```

If the installer reports "E_QUEUE: queue busy", you should wait about 1 minute. Then try again.

## Paper sizes

| Size | Use it for |
|---|---|
| 62 mm | address labels that you send by post |
| 29 mm | small labels for the shelves |

> Do not load third-party rolls. The warranty is void if you do.

For more information about the options, see the [vendor manual](https://example.com/lp-200/manual.pdf).
